markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set, second model agrees, input typical; flagged tier 2 [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99% | Strongly one-sided |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 88th pct | Input usable |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 0, 3, 4) · context · Mean area above 93% of references; variation above 90% · Measured [F7]
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Linked to invasion; near-zero term here · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; slightly negative term here · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 3, 8, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; spot check failed (3/20) · Unreliable [F4]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit drop); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown faithful. Unreliable: normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Necrosis and normal-lobule scores failed spot checks; treat them as unverified.
- One of five similar cases is InSitu; the 90% guarantee is dataset-level.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 0, 8**: highest contributions to the invasive score; confirm invasive growth.
2. **Regions 3, 8, 10**: necrosis score peaks here; verify necrosis is present.
3. **Regions 11, 6, 1**: lowest per-region risk (10–14%); look for benign or in-situ tissue.
